class Event::Description
  include ActionView::Helpers::TagHelper
  include ERB::Util

  attr_reader :event, :user

  def initialize(event, user)
    @event = event
    @user = user
  end

  def to_html
    to_sentence(creator_tag, card_title_tag).html_safe
  end

  def to_plain_text
    to_sentence(creator_name, quoted(card.title)).html_safe
  end

  private
    def to_sentence(creator, card_title)
      if event.action.comment_created?
        comment_sentence(creator, card_title)
      else
        action_sentence(creator, card_title)
      end
    end

    def creator_tag
      tag.span data: { creator_id: event.creator.id } do
        tag.span(I18n.t("models.event_description.you"), data: { only_visible_to_you: true }) +
        tag.span(event.creator.name, data: { only_visible_to_others: true })
      end
    end

    def card_title_tag
      tag.span card.title, class: "txt-underline"
    end

    def creator_name
      h event.creator.name
    end

    def quoted(text)
      h %("#{text}")
    end

    def card
      @card ||= event.action.comment_created? ? event.eventable.card : event.eventable
    end

    def comment_sentence(creator, card_title)
      I18n.t("models.event_description.comment_created", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
    end

    def action_sentence(creator, card_title)
      case event.action
      when "card_assigned"
        assigned_sentence(creator, card_title)
      when "card_unassigned"
        unassigned_sentence(creator, card_title)
      when "card_published"
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_published", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
      when "card_closed"
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_closed", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
      when "card_reopened"
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_reopened", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
      when "card_postponed"
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_postponed", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
      when "card_auto_postponed"
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_auto_postponed", card_title: card_title)
      when "card_resumed"
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_resumed", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
      when "card_title_changed"
        renamed_sentence(creator, card_title)
      when "card_board_changed", "card_collection_changed"
        moved_sentence(creator, card_title)
      when "card_triaged"
        triaged_sentence(creator, card_title)
      when "card_sent_back_to_triage"
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_sent_back_to_triage", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
      end
    end

    def assigned_sentence(creator, card_title)
      if event.assignees.include?(user)
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_assigned_self", creator: creator, card_title: card_title)
      else
        I18n.t("models.event_description.card_assigned", creator: creator, assignees: assignee_names, card_title: card_title)
      end
    end

    def unassigned_sentence(creator, card_title)
      I18n.t("models.event_description.card_unassigned", creator: creator, assignees: unassigned_names, card_title: card_title)
    end

    def renamed_sentence(creator, card_title)
      I18n.t("models.event_description.card_title_changed", creator: creator, card_title: card_title, old_title: old_title)
    end

    def moved_sentence(creator, card_title)
      I18n.t("models.event_description.card_board_changed", creator: creator, card_title: card_title, new_location: new_location)
    end

    def triaged_sentence(creator, card_title)
      I18n.t("models.event_description.card_triaged", creator: creator, card_title: card_title, column: column)
    end

    def assignee_names
      h event.assignees.pluck(:name).to_sentence
    end

    def unassigned_names
      if event.assignees.include?(user)
        h I18n.t("models.event_description.yourself")

    def old_title

    end

    def new_location
      h(event.particulars.dig("particulars", "new_board") || event.particulars.dig("particulars", "new_collection"))
    end

    def column
      h event.particulars.dig("particulars", "column")
    end
end

    when "card_closed"
      if card.closure
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_closed_done", creator: creator)
      else
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_closed", creator: creator)
      end
    when "card_reopened"
      I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_reopened", creator: creator)
    when "card_triaged"
      if column_name.present?
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_triaged_column", column: column_name, creator: creator)
      else
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_triaged", creator: creator)
      end
    when "card_sent_back_to_triage"
      I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_sent_back_to_triage", creator: creator)
    when "card_board_changed", "card_collection_changed"
      if new_location_name.present?
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_board_changed_location", location: new_location_name, creator: creator)
      else
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_board_changed", creator: creator)
      end
    when "card_title_changed"
      if new_title.present?
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_title_changed_title", title: new_title, creator: creator)
      else
        I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_title_changed", creator: creator)
      end
    when "card_postponed"
      I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_postponed", creator: creator)
    when "card_auto_postponed"
      I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_auto_postponed")
    else
      I18n.t("models.notification_payload.default_event", creator: creator)
    end
  end

  def url
    case event.action
    when "comment_created"
      card_url_with_comment_anchor(event.eventable)
    else
      card_url(card)
    end
  end

  def category
    case event.action
    when "card_assigned" then "assignment"
    when "comment_created" then "comment"
    else "card"
    end
  end

  def high_priority?
    event.action.card_assigned?
  end

  private
    def event
      notification.source
    end

    def card_title
      card.title.presence || I18n.t("models.notification_payload.card_fallback_title", number: card.number)
    end

    def event_particulars
      event.particulars.dig("particulars") || {}
    end

    def column_name
      event_particulars["column"]
    end

    def new_location_name
      event_particulars["new_board"] || event_particulars["new_collection"]
    end

    def new_title
      event_particulars["new_title"]
    end

    def card_url_with_comment_anchor(comment)
      Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.card_url(
        comment.card,
        anchor: ActionView::RecordIdentifier.dom_id(comment),
        **url_options
      )
    end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/models/signup/account_name_generator.rb
class Signup::AccountNameGenerator
  SUFFIX = "Fizzy".freeze

  attr_reader :identity, :name

  def initialize(identity:, name:)
    @identity = identity
    @name = name
  end

  def generate
    next_index = current_index + 1

    if next_index == 1
      I18n.t("models.signup.account_name_first", first_name: first_name)
    else
      ordinal = I18n.locale == :en ? next_index.ordinalize : next_index.to_s
      I18n.t("models.signup.account_name_nth", first_name: first_name, ordinal: ordinal)
    end
  end

  private
    def current_index
      existing_indices.max || 0
    end

    def existing_indices
      Current.without_account do
        identity.accounts.filter_map do |account|
          if account.name.match?(first_account_name_regex)
            1
          elsif match = account.name.match(nth_account_name_regex)
            match[1].to_i
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def first_account_name_regex
      @first_account_name_regex ||= /\A#{Regexp.escape(first_name)}(?:'s\s+|の)#{SUFFIX}\z/i
    end

    def nth_account_name_regex
      @nth_account_name_regex ||= /\A#{Regexp.escape(first_name)}(?:'s\s+(1st|2nd|3rd|\d+th)\s+#{SUFFIX}|の#{SUFFIX}\s+(\d+))\z/i
    end

    def first_name
      name.strip.split(" ", 2).first
    end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/models/account/seeder.rb
class Account::Seeder
  attr_reader :account, :creator

  def initialize(account, creator)
    @account = account
    @creator = creator
  end

  def seed
    Current.set(user: creator, account: account) do
      populate
    end
  end

  def seed!
    raise "You can't run in production environments" unless Rails.env.local?

    delete_everything
    seed
  end

  private
    def populate
      # ---------------
      # Playground Board
      # ---------------
      playground = account.boards.create! name: I18n.t("models.seeder.board_name"), creator: creator, all_access: true
      playground.update! auto_postpone_period: 365.days

      # Cards
      %w[ orientation passkey invite home assigned menu assign_self tag columns not_now rename ].each do |card_key|
        playground.cards.create! \
          creator: creator,
          title: I18n.t("models.seeder.cards.#{card_key}_title"),
          status: "published",
          description: I18n.t("models.seeder.cards.#{card_key}_description")
      end
    end

    def delete_everything
      Current.set(user: creator, account: account) do
        account.boards.destroy_all
      end
    end
end
EOF

module AccessesHelper
  def access_menu_tag(board, **options, &)
    tag.menu class: [ options[:class], { "toggler--toggled": board.all_access? } ], data: {
      controller: "filter toggle-class navigable-list",
      action: "keydown->navigable-list#navigate filter:changed->navigable-list#reset",
      navigable_list_focus_on_selection_value: true,
      navigable_list_actionable_items_value: true,
      toggle_class_toggle_class: "toggler--toggled" }, &
  end

  def access_toggles_for(users, selected:, disabled: false)
    render partial: "boards/access_toggle",
      collection: users, as: :user,
      locals: { selected: selected, disabled: disabled },
      cached: ->(user) { [ user, selected, disabled ] }
  end

  def access_involvement_advance_button(board, user, show_watchers: true, icon_only: false)
    access = board.access_for(user)

    turbo_frame_tag dom_id(board, :involvement_button) do
      concat board_watchers_list(board) if show_watchers
      concat involvement_button(board, access, show_watchers, icon_only)
    end
  end

  def board_watchers_list(board)
    watchers = board.watchers.with_avatars.load

    displayed_watchers = watchers.first(8)
    overflow_count = watchers.size - 8

    tag.div(class: "divider divider--fade") do
      tag.strong(watchers.any? ? t("helpers.accesses.watching_for_new_cards") : t("helpers.accesses.no_one_watching_for_new_cards"), class: "txt-uppercase")
    end +
    tag.div(avatar_tags(displayed_watchers), class: "board-tools__watching") do
      tag.div(data: { controller: "dialog", action: "keydown.esc->dialog#close click@document->dialog#closeOnClickOutside" }) do
        tag.button("+#{overflow_count}", class: "overflow-count btn btn--circle borderless", data: { action: "dialog#open" }, aria: { label: t("helpers.accesses.show_more_watchers", count: overflow_count) }) +
        tag.dialog(avatar_tags(watchers), class: "board-tools__watching-dialog dialog panel", data: { dialog_target: "dialog" }, aria: { hidden: "true" })
      end if overflow_count > 0
    end
  end

  def involvement_button(board, access, show_watchers, icon_only)
    label_text = access.access_only? ? t("helpers.accesses.watch_this") : t("helpers.accesses.stop_watching")
    button_to(
      board_involvement_path(board), method: :put,
      params: { show_watchers: show_watchers, involvement: next_involvement(access.involvement), icon_only: icon_only },
      aria: { labelledby: dom_id(board, :involvement_label) },
      title: (label_text if icon_only),
      class: class_names("btn", { "btn--reversed": access.watching? && icon_only }),
      data: !icon_only && { bridge__overflow_menu_target: "item", bridge_title: label_text }) do
        icon_tag("notification-bell-#{icon_only ? 'reverse-' : nil}#{access.involvement.dasherize}") +
        tag.span(label_text, class: class_names("txt-nowrap txt-uppercase", "for-screen-reader": icon_only), id: dom_id(board, :involvement_label))
    end
  end

  private
    def next_involvement(involvement)
      order = %w[ watching access_only ]
      order[(order.index(involvement.to_s) + 1) % order.size]
    end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/helpers/pagination_helper.rb
module PaginationHelper
  def pagination_frame_tag(namespace, page, data: {}, **attributes, &)
    turbo_frame_tag pagination_frame_id_for(namespace, page.number), data: { timeline_target: "frame", **data }, role: "presentation", **attributes, &
  end

  def link_to_next_page(namespace, page, activate_when_observed: false, label: default_pagination_label(activate_when_observed), data: {}, **attributes)
    if page.before_last? && !params[:previous]
      attributes[:class] = class_names(attributes[:class], "btn txt-small center-block center": !activate_when_observed)
      pagination_link(namespace, page.number + 1, label: label, activate_when_observed: activate_when_observed, data: data, **attributes)
    end
  end

  def pagination_link(namespace, page_number, activate_when_observed: false, label: default_pagination_label(activate_when_observed), url_params: {}, data: {}, **attributes)
    link_to label, url_for(params.permit!.to_h.merge(page: page_number, **url_params)),
      "aria-label": t("helpers.pagination.load_page", page: page_number),
      id: "#{namespace}-pagination-link-#{page_number}",
      class: class_names(attributes.delete(:class), "pagination-link", { "pagination-link--active-when-observed" => activate_when_observed }),
      data: {
        frame: pagination_frame_id_for(namespace, page_number),
        pagination_target: "paginationLink",
        action: ("click->pagination#loadPage:prevent" unless activate_when_observed),
        **data
      },
      **attributes
  end

  def pagination_frame_id_for(namespace, page_number)
    "#{namespace}-pagination-contents-#{page_number}"
  end

  def with_manual_pagination(name, page, **properties)
    pagination_list name, **properties do
      concat(pagination_frame_tag(name, page) do
        yield
        concat link_to_next_page(name, page)
      end)
    end
  end

  def with_automatic_pagination(name, page, **properties)
    pagination_list name, paginate_on_scroll: true, **properties do
      concat(pagination_frame_tag(name, page) do
        yield
        concat link_to_next_page(name, page, activate_when_observed: true)
      end)
    end
  end

  def day_timeline_pagination_frame_tag(day_timeline, &)
    turbo_frame_tag day_timeline_pagination_frame_id_for(day_timeline.day), data: { timeline_target: "frame" }, role: "presentation", refresh: :morph, &
  end

  def day_timeline_pagination_frame_id_for(day)
    "day-timeline-pagination-contents-#{day.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}"
  end

  def day_timeline_pagination_link(day_timeline, filter)
    if day_timeline.next_day
      link_to t("helpers.pagination.load_more"), events_days_path(day: day_timeline.next_day.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), **filter.as_params),
        class: "day-timeline-pagination-link", data: { frame: day_timeline_pagination_frame_id_for(day_timeline.next_day), pagination_target: "paginationLink" }
    end
  end

  private
    def pagination_list(name, tag_element: :div, paginate_on_scroll: false, **properties, &block)
      classes = properties.delete(:class)
      properties[:id] ||= "#{name}-pagination-list"
      tag.public_send tag_element,
        class: token_list(name, "display-contents", classes),
        data: { controller: "pagination", pagination_paginate_on_intersection_value: paginate_on_scroll },
        **properties,
        &block
    end

    def default_pagination_label(activate_when_observed)
      t("helpers.pagination.load_more")
    end
end
EOF

**Domain 1 Localization Deep Dive**

Okay, let's break this down. We need to tackle localization across Domain 1, and I've got a solid plan forming. I've taken a close look at every single detail. Starting with the core layouts, `application.html.erb` and `public.html.erb`, I see the standard `<html lang="<%= I18n.locale %>">` and the data attributes `data-locale` and `data-i18n` on the `<body>`. That's the baseline. The "Skip to main content" is a solid accessibility touch. Then there's that clever use of `data-turbo-permanent` on `id="footer_frames_<%= I18n.locale %>` – brilliant! We're avoiding stale footer frames on locale switch with Turbo, because the ID is scoped to the locale, and no CSS/JS targets the base ID.

Moving deeper, the `_lightbox.html.erb` with the `aria-label` and the "(esc)" close hint is a clean implementation for accessibility. The `_colophon.html.erb` with the Fizzy™/37signals™ attribution, and the `_welcome_letter.html.erb` with the "Close dialog", headings, paragraphs, and signature title also need attention.

The `_bar.html.erb` has a simple "Search" label. We can't forget Active Storage components either. We have to make sure that the `_blob.html.erb` has a localized `title` attribute for downloads, and that the `web/_representation.html.erb` has a fallback for the file extension. The `pwa/manifest.json.erb` is a goldmine for localization, with descriptions, notifications, and "Catch up on...", "Latest Activity" and "See what's new" strings.

Finally, we hit the boards – that's a lot of content! We've got column headings like "Done," "Not now," "Maybe?" and card states like "No cards here" and "Maximize column." Note the use of `data-column-name="<%= t("views.columns.maybe") %>"`, which is a good hint.

Okay, the plan is simple. I'm going to create `config/locales/en/views_shared.yml` and `config/locales/ja/views_shared.yml`. Then, I'll systematically go through *every single one* of these Domain 1 views and update them with the appropriate translations. This should be straightforward, but detail-oriented to ensure a thorough and accurate localization. Let's get to work!

  belongs_to :event

  store :response, coder: JSON

  scope :stale, -> { where(created_at: ...STALE_TRESHOLD.ago) }

    sleep pause until stale.limit(batch_size).delete_all.zero?
  end

    Webhook::DeliveryJob.perform_later(self)
  end

  def deliver
    in_progress!

    self.request[:headers] = headers
    self.response = perform_request
    self.state = :completed
    save!

    webhook.delinquency_tracker.record_delivery_of(self)
  rescue
    errored!
    raise
  end

    if headers = request&.dig("headers")&.except("X-Webhook-Signature")
      { headers: headers }
    end
  end

  def response_summary
    if response.present?
      { code: response[:code], error: response[:error] }
    end
  end

  def failed?
    (errored? || completed?) && !succeeded?
  end

  def succeeded?
    completed? && response[:error].blank? && response[:code].between?(200, 299)
  end

  private
    def perform_request
      if resolved_ip.nil?
        { error: :private_uri }
      else
        request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri, headers).tap { |request| request.body = payload }

        response = http.request(request) do |net_http_response|
          stream_body_with_limit(net_http_response)
        end

        { code: response.code.to_i }
      end
    rescue ResponseTooLarge
      { error: :response_too_large }
    rescue Resolv::ResolvTimeout, Resolv::ResolvError, SocketError
      { error: :dns_lookup_failed }
    rescue Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout, Errno::ETIMEDOUT
      { error: :connection_timeout }
    rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED, Errno::EHOSTUNREACH, Errno::ECONNRESET, Errno::EPERM
      { error: :destination_unreachable }
    rescue OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError
      { error: :failed_tls }
    end

    def stream_body_with_limit(response)
      bytes_read = 0
      response.read_body do |chunk|
        bytes_read += chunk.bytesize
        raise ResponseTooLarge if bytes_read > MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE
      end
    end

    def resolved_ip
      return @resolved_ip if defined?(@resolved_ip)
      @resolved_ip = SsrfProtection.resolve_public_ip(uri.host)
    end

    def uri
      @uri ||= URI(webhook.url)
    end

    def http
      Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port).tap do |http|
        http.ipaddr = resolved_ip
        http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == "https")
        http.open_timeout = ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT
        http.read_timeout = ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT
      end
    end

    def headers
      {
        "User-Agent" => USER_AGENT,
        "Content-Type" => content_type,
        "X-Webhook-Signature" => signature,
        "X-Webhook-Timestamp" => event.created_at.utc.iso8601
      }
    end

    def signature
      OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest("SHA256", webhook.signing_secret, payload)
    end

    def content_type
      if webhook.for_campfire?
        "text/html"
      elsif webhook.for_basecamp?
        "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
      else
        "application/json"
      end
    end

    def payload
      @payload ||= if webhook.for_basecamp?
        { content: render_payload(formats: :html) }.to_query
      elsif webhook.for_campfire?
        render_payload(formats: :html)
      elsif webhook.for_slack?
        slack_payload
      else
        render_payload(formats: :json)
      end
    end

    def render_payload(**options)
      webhook.renderer.render(layout: false, template: "webhooks/event", assigns: { event: event }, **options).strip
    end

    def convert_html_to_mrkdwn(html)
      document = Nokogiri::HTML5(html)

      document.css("a").each do |a|
        a.replace("<#{a["href"].strip}|#{a.text}>") if a["href"].present?
      end

      document.css("b").each do |b|
        b.replace("*#{b.text}*")
      end

      document.css("i").each do |i|
        i.replace("_#{i.text}_")
      end

      document.text
    end

    def slack_payload
      text = event.description_for(nil).to_plain_text
      url = polymorphic_url(event.eventable, base_url_options.merge(script_name: account.slug))

      { text: "#{text} <#{url}|Open in Fizzy>" }.to_json
    end

    def base_url_options
      Rails.application.routes.default_url_options.presence ||
        Rails.application.config.action_mailer.default_url_options
    end
end

messages.thinking: **Domain 5 Localization Blitz: Let's Get This Done!** Okay, this is fantastic! I've just meticulously reviewed every nook and cranny of Domain 5, and the localization opportunities are *everywhere*. Let's break this down systematically. First, let's nail that card numbering in `cards/display/common/_board.html.erb` and `app/assets/stylesheets/cards.css`. The current "No." is a prime candidate for `data-number-prefix`. The English is fine, but for Japanese, the `#` symbol is super clean and universal. However, "番号" (meaning "number") fits so well visually in Japanese UIs, especially given the `.card__id` styling, which has enough flex-shrink that the two CJK characters should perfectly match the width of "No." So, in the CSS, `content: attr(data-number-prefix)` with `data-number-prefix` set appropriately for each language. I'll need to double-check that `.card__id` doesn't have overflow issues. Next, the timestamps and user attributions in `cards/display/common/_stamp.html.erb` need attention. I'm going to leverage the `l()` helper for date formatting with `:stamp` format. This cleans up the Ruby code significantly. The "Not Now" / "Done" labels also need internationalization. And that `by ...` can be better as a template that uses `%` style interpolation to improve maintainability. Moving onto `cards/display/common/_meta.html.erb`, `cards/display/public_preview/_meta.html.erb`, and `cards/display/preview/_meta.html.erb`, we've got a goldmine. Let's convert all the datetime tags into localized strings using `t()`, to format the "Added" and "Updated" timestamps in a way that feels natural in each language (like how the Japanese is constructed). The "By" string and assignment status are perfect candidates for `t()`. Let's make sure the aria labels in `preview/_meta.html.erb` are translated too. Then, there's `cards/comments/_comment.html.erb`. Those timestamps should be templated using `t()`, to have full control on the formatting in each language. Let's make sure to translate "Full history" and "Edit this comment" too. In `cards/comments/_watchers.html.erb`, the pluralization and sentence structure surrounding "Subscribers" and the notification sentence is critical. Time for `t()` and `pluralize()`. The closure information in `cards/container/_closure.html.erb` is a slam-dunk. The "Completed by" and "Moves to" strings are crying out for `t()` to improve the readability. The `reactions` views are also brimming with localizable content. The `title` attributes, `aria-label` attributes, and button text (e.g., "Delete this reaction", "Add your own reaction", "Submit", "Cancel") need to be templated. Finally, in `prompts/boards/users/_user.html.erb`, we need to make sure the search attribute works in both languages. We'll add `"自分"` (which is the Japanese word for "me") alongside the English "me" when the locale is Japanese. Alright, the game plan is clear. I want to ensure every screen and email renders correctly in Japanese, including date formats. I'll make sure the static error pages are localized and that users who never choose a language stay in English. Finally, I'll need to check fragment cache isolation between locales.

bin/rails runner '
require "yaml"

def flatten_hash(h, prefix = "", out = {})
  h.each do |k, v|
    key = prefix.empty? ? k.to_s : "#{prefix}.#{k}"
    if v.is_a?(Hash)
      flatten_hash(v, key, out)
    else
      out[key] = v
    end
  end
  out
end

en_files = Dir["config/locales/en/*.yml"] + ["config/locales/en.yml"]
ja_files = Dir["config/locales/ja/*.yml"] + ["config/locales/ja.yml"]

en_all = {}
ja_all = {}

en_files.each { |f| data = YAML.load_file(f); flatten_hash(data["en"] || {}, "", en_all) }
ja_files.each { |f| data = YAML.load_file(f); flatten_hash(data["ja"] || {}, "", ja_all) }

rails_core_prefixes = %w[date. datetime. errors. activerecord. activemodel. helpers.select helpers.submit number. support. time.]
app_en_keys = en_all.keys.reject { |k| rails_core_prefixes.any? { |p| k.start_with?(p) } }
app_ja_keys = ja_all.keys.reject { |k| rails_core_prefixes.any? { |p| k.start_with?(p) } }

missing_in_ja = app_en_keys - app_ja_keys
missing_in_en = app_ja_keys - app_en_keys

puts "App EN keys: #{app_en_keys.size}, App JA keys: #{app_ja_keys.size}"
puts "Missing in JA (#{missing_in_ja.size}): #{missing_in_ja.inspect}"
puts "Missing in EN (#{missing_in_en.size}): #{missing_in_en.inspect}"

# Check interpolation variable parity
var_mismatches = []
(app_en_keys & app_ja_keys).each do |k|
  en_vars = en_all[k].to_s.scan(/%\{(\w+)\}/).flatten.uniq.sort
  ja_vars = ja_all[k].to_s.scan(/%\{(\w+)\}/).flatten.uniq.sort
  if en_vars != ja_vars
    var_mismatches << [k, en_vars, ja_vars]
  end
end
puts "Interpolation mismatches (#{var_mismatches.size}): #{var_mismatches.inspect}"

# Check any JA app value that is identical to EN (possible untranslated string)
same_values = []
(app_en_keys & app_ja_keys).each do |k|
  if en_all[k].is_a?(String) && en_all[k] == ja_all[k]
    same_values << [k, en_all[k]]
  end
end
puts "Identical EN/JA values (#{same_values.size}):"
same_values.each { |k, v| puts "  #{k}: #{v.inspect}" }
'

messages.thinking:
Okay, here's what I'm thinking, as if I'm mentally processing this data:

**Impressive! A Nearly Perfect Localization Setup!**

WHOA! Check this out! My initial analysis of the language keys is looking fantastic. I'm seeing a perfect match: 1006 keys in both the English (EN) and Japanese (JA) locales. No missing keys in either language, and, even better, zero interpolation mismatches! Honestly, that's incredibly rare to see right off the bat. It looks like the localization process was executed flawlessly.

The only identical values are three totally expected cases—the ubiquitous `"OK"`, the developer-focused `"DEV"`, and a generic string with variable insertion (`"%{label}…"`). This is all totally in line with best practices.

Now, let's not get complacent. I need to do a really thorough scan, a deep dive into the code. I'm going to systematically comb through every single `.erb` file in the `app/views/` directory. My aim is to root out any lingering hardcoded English text lurking in those views. I'm looking for everything: from the obvious text strings to those sneaky attributes – `aria-label`, `title`, `alt`, `placeholder`, `data-confirm`, `turbo_confirm`, `bridge_title`, `validation_message`, `@page_title`, as well as any use of methods that output text such as `strftime`, `pluralize`, `humanize`, and `titleize`. I don't want any stray English creeping into the Japanese experience!

And I won't stop there. I also have to check `client_configurations/*.json` and `*.json.jbuilder` files. I need to be 100% sure that there aren't any untranslated strings floating around in configuration or API data. The goal is complete localization, no shortcuts. This is the only way to be completely confident that the application is fully internationalized.

arguments.command:
ruby -e '
require "nokogiri"

Dir.glob("app/views/**/*.erb").sort.each do |file|
  next if file.end_with?(".js.erb", ".json.erb", ".svg.erb")
  raw = File.read(file)

  issues = []

  # 1. Check ERB tags for suspicious hardcoded strings
  raw.scan(/<%[=-]?(.*?)%>/m).each do |match|
    code = match[0]
    next if code.strip.start_with?("#")
    if code =~ /@page_title\s*=\s*"[^"]*[A-Za-z]{2,}/
      issues << "page_title: #{code.strip}"
    end
    if code =~ /\b(placeholder|title|alt|aria_label|turbo_confirm|bridge_title|bridge_description|validation_message|label):\s*"[^"]*[A-Za-z]{2,}/
      issues << "erb attr: #{code.strip[0..120]}"
    end
    if code =~ /"label":\s*"[^"]*[A-Za-z]{2,}/ || code =~ /label:\s*"[A-Z][a-z]+/
      issues << "erb label: #{code.strip[0..120]}"
    end
    if code =~ /\.strftime\(/ && code !~ /%Y-%m-%d/
      issues << "strftime: #{code.strip}"
    end
    if code =~ /\bpluralize\b/
      issues << "pluralize: #{code.strip}"
    end
    if code =~ /\.(humanize|titleize)\b/ && code !~ /default:/
      issues << "humanize/titleize: #{code.strip}"
    end
    if code =~ /\b(link_to|button_to|button_tag|submit|filter_title|filter_dialog|back_link_to|collapsible_nav_section|filter_place_menu_item|filter_hotkey_link)\s+["'\''][A-Za-z]/
      issues << "helper literal: #{code.strip[0..120]}"
    end
  end

  # 2. Strip ERB tags and check visible HTML text & HTML attributes
  stripped = raw.gsub(/<%#.*?%>/m, "").gsub(/<%.*?%>/m, " ")
  doc = Nokogiri::HTML::DocumentFragment.parse(stripped)
  doc.traverse do |node|
    if node.text?
      next if %w[style script].include?(node.parent&.name)
      text = node.text.strip
      # Flag any text with >=2 consecutive ASCII letters (excluding single hotkeys/entities/brand names)
      words = text.scan(/[A-Za-z]{2,}/) - %w[Fizzy Basecamp HEY signals Jason Fried jason com ESC HTML UTF amp nbsp ldquo rdquo lsquo rsquo ZIP PDF URL API]
      if words.any?
        issues << "HTML text: #{text.inspect}"
      end
    elsif node.element?
      %w[aria-label aria-description title alt placeholder data-turbo-confirm data-bridge-title data-validation-message data-text].each do |attr|
        val = node[attr]
        if val && val.strip =~ /[A-Za-z]{2,}/
          words = val.scan(/[A-Za-z]{2,}/) - %w[Fizzy]
          issues << "HTML #{attr}=#{val.inspect}" if words.any?
        end
      end
    end
  end

  if issues.any?
    puts "=== #{file} ==="
    issues.uniq.each { |i| puts "  - #{i}" }
  end
end
'

messages.thinking:
**Localization Audit Deep Dive**

Okay, the initial `git diff` check confirmed it: the new untracked locale file is there. Clean start! Now, it's time for the real audit, a full Japanese rendering review across the entire application—every screen, every email. This is where those sneaky hardcoded English strings and translation bugs surface.

To ensure comprehensive coverage, I'm going to write a set of meticulous tests in `localization_test.rb`, `localization_mailer_test.rb`, and `localization_test.rb`. These tests will focus on:

1.  **Locale Switching:** Robustly testing the `?locale=ja` parameter on both authenticated and unauthenticated pages, ensuring the Japanese locale sticks throughout the session.
2.  **Session Persistence:** Verifying that the chosen locale persists across multiple requests, even after the initial `?locale=` parameter is dropped, and remains consistent throughout the user session.
3.  **Cross-Session Consistency:** Guaranteeing that the locale choice holds true even after signing out and back in from a completely fresh browser session.
4.  **Magic Link Integration:** Validating that `?locale=ja` set before signing in through a magic link persists to the user's identity and future logins, even from clean browsers.
5.  **Redirect Endpoint Handling:** Ensuring that `?locale=ja` works correctly on redirecting endpoints (e.g., `/` to `/session/menu`, `/signup` to `/signup/new`).
6.  **Invalid Locale Handling:** Crucially, testing how the application behaves with invalid or unsupported locales (e.g., `?locale=xx`, `?locale[]=ja`). The tests will confirm that invalid locales *never* break pages or switch away from the current locale, maintaining `:en` or `:ja` as appropriate.
7.  **English Return:** Ensuring the application can cleanly switch back to English with `?locale=en` and that this change also persists.
8.  **Default English Rendering:** Verifying that users who never choose a locale consistently see everything in English, including the HTML `<html lang="en">` attribute.
9.  **User Isolation:** Making sure a Japanese user's locale setting doesn't leak to a new user who logs in on the same browser and has never selected a locale.
10. **Fragment Cache Isolation:** Testing and confirming fragment cache isolation in ensuring that rendering the same cached data in `:en`, `:ja`, and back to `:en` always returns the correct language.
11. **Japanese Screen Coverage:** Exhaustively testing every single screen rendered in Japanese (as listed in the text) and thoroughly inspecting the rendered HTML to identify and eliminate any remaining English UI elements or missing translations.
12. **Comprehensive Email Testing:** Meticulously testing all emails in both Japanese and English. This will include Japanese dates, subjects, HTML parts, and text parts. Specifically, I'll be auditing:
    *   `MagicLinkMailer.sign_in_instructions` (for sign-in and sign-up) with both saved `identity.locale = "ja"` and clean-identity scenarios.
    *   `AccountMailer.cancellation` (with `distance_of_time_in_words` in Japanese).
    *   `ExportMailer.completed` (account export & user data export).
    *   `ImportMailer.completed` & `ImportMailer.failed` (conflict, invalid_export, generic).
    *   `UserMailer.email_change_confirmation`.

module User::Named
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    scope :alphabetically, -> { order("lower(name)") }
  end

  def name
    if system? && super == "System"
      I18n.t("helpers.users.roles.system")
    else
      super
    end
  end

  def first_name
    name.split(/\s/).first
  end

  def last_name
    name.split(/\s/, 2).last
  end

  def initials
    name.scan(/\b\p{L}/).join.upcase
  end

  def familiar_name
    names = name.split
    return name if names.length <= 1
    "#{names.first}\u00A0#{names[1..].map { |n| "#{n[0]}." }.join}"
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class LocalizationTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "en and ja locale files have complete key and interpolation parity" do
    en_all = load_locale_keys("en")
    ja_all = load_locale_keys("ja")

    rails_core_prefixes = %w[ date. datetime. errors. activerecord. activemodel. helpers.select helpers.submit number. support. time. ]
    app_en_keys = en_all.keys.reject { |k| rails_core_prefixes.any? { |p| k.start_with?(p) } }
    app_ja_keys = ja_all.keys.reject { |k| rails_core_prefixes.any? { |p| k.start_with?(p) } }

    assert_empty app_en_keys - app_ja_keys, "Keys missing in ja"
    assert_empty app_ja_keys - app_en_keys, "Keys missing in en"

    (app_en_keys & app_ja_keys).each do |key|
      en_vars = en_all[key].to_s.scan(/%\{(\w+)\}/).flatten.uniq.sort
      ja_vars = ja_all[key].to_s.scan(/%\{(\w+)\}/).flatten.uniq.sort
      assert_equal en_vars, ja_vars, "Interpolation mismatch for key #{key}"
    end
  end

  test "models render Japanese strings under :ja locale" do
    I18n.with_locale(:ja) do
      assert_equal "システム", accounts(:"37s").system_user.name
      assert_equal "今日", TimeWindowParser.human_name_for("today")
      assert_equal "完了", Filter.indexed_by_human_name("closed")
      assert_equal "AまたはB", %w[ A B ].to_choice_sentence
      assert_equal "A、BまたはC", %w[ A B C ].to_choice_sentence

      description = events(:logo_published).description_for(users(:david))
      assert_includes description.to_plain_text, "追加しました"

      notification = Notification.new(user: users(:david), creator: users(:jz), source: events(:logo_published), card: cards(:logo), account: accounts(:"37s"))
      assert_includes notification.payload.body, "が追加しました"

      webhook = Webhook.new(board: boards(:writebook), name: "Test", url: "not-a-url")
      assert_not webhook.valid?
      assert_includes webhook.errors[:url], "は有効なURLではありません"
    end
  end

  test "Identity validates locale against available locales" do
    identity = identities(:david)
    identity.locale = "ja"
    assert identity.valid?

    identity.locale = "en"
    assert identity.valid?

    identity.locale = nil
    assert identity.valid?

    identity.locale = "xx"
    assert_not identity.valid?
  end

  private
    def load_locale_keys(locale)
      files = Dir[Rails.root.join("config/locales/#{locale}/*.yml")] + [ Rails.root.join("config/locales/#{locale}.yml").to_s ]
      files.each_with_object({}) do |file, acc|
        data = YAML.load_file(file)
        flatten_hash(data[locale] || {}, "", acc)
      end
    end

    def flatten_hash(hash, prefix, out)
      hash.each do |k, v|
        key = prefix.empty? ? k.to_s : "#{prefix}.#{k}"
        if v.is_a?(Hash)
          flatten_hash(v, key, out)
        else
          out[key] = v
        end
      end
      out
    end
end
EOF
